node.label: GST collections & indirect taxes
node.summary: Monthly GST mop-up figures and indirect-tax trends.

facts.text: GST collections rose **23% y-o-y in October to ₹2.31 lakh crore** — the second-highest monthly figure ever and the fastest growth this fiscal year; October was the second straight month gross GST crossed ₹2 lakh crore, and April-October gross GST collection grew 13.2% to over ₹14.77 lakh crore.
